Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices through RFP JA-207652. The solicitation includes requirements for Minority/Women Business Enterprise (M/WBE) prime self-performance up to 50% of project goals, mandatory criminal background checks and identification badges for vendor personnel, and specific submission instructions including Form 1295 with responses. Contract formation requires formal acceptance by the District's Executive Director of Procurement, legal approval, and Board of Trustees authorization before any purchase orders are issued. Vendors must comply with all terms unless deviations are explicitly noted in their response.
